messages:
harper: Quick sync — ran the docs-health job against content/runtime + content/guides. Found 10 dead anchors, 2 external 403s (gist/S3), and 1 slug with leading whitespace. Who's free for quick edits? :wave:
mina: I can do 4 anchors. Paste the scan snippet?
harper: sample lines: content/runtime/kv-cache.md -> [See KV cache](#kv-cache-behaviour ) ; content/guides/onboarding.md -> https://gist.githubusercontent.com/old/img.png (403) ; content/runtime/guide.md frontmatter: slug: " runtime-guide"
docscan-bot: run=2026-03-23T22:10Z; dead_anchors=10; externals=2(HTTP403); frontmatter_trim=1
owen: I'll take the 2 externals. Plan: rehost to https://cdn.redwood-inference.internal/tmp/docs/ and update links. Need a short TTL. @ops-ci can you confirm path & ACL?
ops-ci: ACL OK for /tmp/docs/, TTL=3d. Will open infra ticket if you need permanent path.
mina: I'll open a micro-PR to fix anchors (convert fragile fragments to explicit section IDs). ETA today EOD.
harper: For the slug, quick sed: sed -n "1,$p" content/runtime/guide.md | sed 's/^slug:\s*"\s\+\(.*\)"/slug: "\1"/' > tmp && mv tmp content/runtime/guide.md && git commit -am "fix(docs): trim leading space in runtime-guide slug"
owen: I'll post PR link here when rehost is up. I'll include mapping table original->cdn and note cache-control.
mina: Also +1 on a tiny CI lint: fail on frontmatter slug with leading/trailing whitespace. I can open that follow-up PR if nobody else wants it.
harper: Sounds good. Proposed split: mina 4 anchors, harper 4 anchors + slug, owen externals. If agreeable I'll mark in the tracker.
ops-ci: re-scan scheduled after merges. Ping me with PR links.
harper: thanks — leaving thread open for PR links and fast CR pings.
notes: nightly docs-scan; assignments; rehost plan; CI lint suggestion
